zh.stance: 承诺远超到位资金，压力链从 OpenAI 的付款一路传到园区项目贷款
zh.verdict: 图上 $1.84T 的算力采购承诺，是买方未来 5–8 年要付的钱；买方手里已经到位的，只有股权融资和已提款的贷款。两边对不上：OpenAI 承诺采购 $730B，已到位的股权 $114B、贷款 $5.2B；Anthropic 承诺 $506B，到位股权 $66B。按板块看，模型实验室承诺付给云厂商 $933B，资金方投给实验室的只有 $357B。缺口要靠实验室未来的收入或新一轮融资来填，而这两样目前都不在图里。

where.text: 顶部四张卡片：订单 $1.84T 是标题口径；把「口径」切到已约束，只剩 $254B（14%）。差额就是「up to」、意向书和多年总额。
最大敞口 → OpenAI：订单支出 $730B，股权流入标题 $200B、已到位 $114B，借入 $5.2B。Anthropic 同理：承诺 $506B，到位股权 $66B。
板块流向：模型实验室 → 超大规模云 $933B，资金方 → 模型实验室 $357B；实验室承诺出去的钱是收进来的 2.6 倍。
集中度：Oracle 在手合同 $327B 里 92% 来自 OpenAI，Microsoft $280B 里 89%；两家的在手合同已约束金额都未披露。

zh.chain_title: 如果 OpenAI 的钱不到位，按图上的边会这样传导
chain: OpenAI 对 Oracle 的 $300B 合同 2027 年起付。OpenAI 已到位的 $114B 股权加 $5.2B 贷款覆盖不了 5 年合同，缺口要靠新融资或收入。
Oracle 为此向 Vantage、Crusoe、Related 等开发商租园区，又发了 $50.8B 公募债。租约不随 OpenAI 付款而免除，所以 OpenAI 一旦付慢，第一个顶上的是 Oracle 自己的现金流和这 $50.8B 债的持有人。
开发商的园区靠项目贷款建：Vantage Frontier $23B、Vantage Lighthouse $15B（两笔均为报道，未经申报确认）、Crusoe / Blue Owl Abilene $7.1B（已签约）。贷款靠 Oracle 租金偿还，Oracle 若也拖欠，摩根大通、Blue Owl 等贷款人才真正暴露。
芯片厂商的担保排在更后面：NVIDIA 对 OpenAI 4.25 GW 租约的 $105B 残值担保要到 2028 年起租才生效，兜的是出租人 SB Energy，不是 Oracle 或开发商。
Anthropic 这条链更短：TPU 租赁 SPV 向 Apollo 借 $35B，靠 Anthropic 的租金还；Anthropic 一旦欠付，Broadcom 按 85% 欠付额减机架处置价值兜底、上限约 $29B，风险直接转到 Broadcom 的资产负债表，而 Broadcom 自己还有 $18.5B 公募债在外。

watch.if: OpenAI 在 2027 年 Oracle 合同起付前没有新的大额股权或债务到位
watch.then: 上面第 2、3 步开始兑现：先看 Oracle 的现金流和债券价格，再看三笔园区项目贷款
watch.watch: OpenAI 下一轮融资公告；Oracle 10-Q 的 RPO 与客户集中度；园区项目贷款的评级动作

watch.if: Anthropic 的 TPU 租约出现欠付
watch.then: Broadcom 兜底触发，Apollo $35B 贷款的信用风险转到 Broadcom，其公募债会同步重新定价
watch.watch: Anthropic S-1 之后的季度收入；Broadcom 10-Q 中 backstop 敞口的变动

watch.if: 芯片厂商按部署分期的投资（NVIDIA、AMD 对 OpenAI / Anthropic / xAI）与采购分期同步放缓
watch.then: 15 条已约束口径的资金闭环两端同时缩水：图上表现为股权与订单的已约束口径一起下降而标题不变
watch.watch: NVIDIA、AMD 财报附注里的投资承诺余额；实验室的 GW 部署进度

zh.flip: OpenAI 或 Anthropic 新一轮股权到位并进入图里，两家的「股权流入（已约束）」明显抬升；或 Oracle、Microsoft 在申报中披露在手合同的已约束金额，订单的已约束占比从 14% 明显上升。出现任一项，这里的判断会重写。

en.stance: Commitments far exceed funded capital; the stress path runs from OpenAI's payments down to campus project loans
en.verdict: The $1.84T of compute purchase commitments on the map is money buyers will pay over the next 5–8 years; what they actually hold is equity raised and loans drawn. The two do not match: OpenAI has committed $730B of purchases against $114B of funded equity and $5.2B of debt; Anthropic $506B against $66B of funded equity. By sector, AI labs have promised $933B to hyperscalers while financiers have put $357B into the labs. The gap has to be filled by future lab revenue or new funding rounds, and neither is on the map yet.

where.text: Top cards: the $1.84T of orders is the headline basis; switch the basis to firm and only $254B (14%) remains. The difference is "up to", letters of intent and multi-year totals.
Largest exposures → OpenAI: orders placed $730B; equity in $200B headline, $114B funded; borrowed $5.2B. Anthropic likewise: $506B committed vs $66B funded equity.
Sector flows: AI labs → hyperscalers $933B, financiers → AI labs $357B; labs have promised out 2.6× what they have taken in.
Concentration: 92% of Oracle's $327B backlog comes from OpenAI, 89% of Microsoft's $280B; neither discloses the firm portion.

en.chain_title: If OpenAI's money does not arrive, this is how it travels along the map's edges
chain: OpenAI's $300B contract with Oracle starts paying in 2027. OpenAI's funded $114B of equity plus $5.2B of debt cannot cover a 5-year contract; the gap needs new funding or revenue.

Oracle leases campuses from Vantage, Crusoe and Related to serve it, and has issued $50.8B of public bonds. The leases are not excused by OpenAI's payments, so if OpenAI pays slowly, the first to absorb it is Oracle's own cash flow and the holders of that $50.8B.

The developers build on project loans: Vantage Frontier $23B and Vantage Lighthouse $15B (both reported, not confirmed in filings), Crusoe / Blue Owl Abilene $7.1B (signed). Those loans are repaid from Oracle's rent; only if Oracle also falls behind are lenders such as JPMorgan and Blue Owl truly exposed.

Chip vendors' guarantees sit further back: NVIDIA's $105B residual-value guarantee on OpenAI's 4.25 GW leases only takes effect at lease start in 2028, and it backstops the lessor SB Energy, not Oracle or the developers.

Anthropic's chain is shorter: its TPU lease SPV borrows $35B from Apollo, repaid from Anthropic's rent; if Anthropic defaults, Broadcom's backstop (85% of arrears less rack disposal value, capped near $29B) moves the risk straight onto Broadcom's balance sheet, which already carries $18.5B of public bonds.

watch.if: OpenAI raises no major new equity or debt before the Oracle contract starts paying in 2027
watch.then: steps 2 and 3 above start to play out: watch Oracle's cash flow and bond prices first, then the three campus project loans
watch.watch: OpenAI's next funding announcement; RPO and customer concentration in Oracle's 10-Q; rating actions on the campus loans

watch.if: Anthropic falls behind on its TPU lease
watch.then: Broadcom's backstop triggers, the credit risk of Apollo's $35B loan moves to Broadcom, and Broadcom's own bonds reprice with it
watch.watch: Anthropic's quarterly revenue after the S-1; the backstop exposure in Broadcom's 10-Q

watch.if: chip vendors' milestone-based investments (NVIDIA and AMD into OpenAI / Anthropic / xAI) slow together with the purchase milestones
watch.then: both ends of the 15 firm-basis funding loops shrink at once: on the map, firm equity and firm orders fall together while headlines stay put
watch.watch: investment commitment balances in NVIDIA's and AMD's filing notes; the labs' GW deployment progress

en.flip: If OpenAI or Anthropic closes a new equity round that enters the map, their firm equity inflow rises visibly; or if Oracle and Microsoft disclose the firm portion of their backlogs, the firm share of orders rises well above 14%. Either one rewrites this call.
en.note: This states only deals verifiable on the map and their trigger conditions; it is not a rating of any company or investment advice.
